77000.commentary: (THa) cittahetū'ti ekadā nigaṇṭho, ekadā paribbājak'ādiko honto anavaṭṭhitacitto puriso viya cittavasiko hutvā.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ alakkhyā ahirikkatāya vā, na cittahetū na ca dūrakantanā, ājīvahetū ca ahaṃ na nikkhamiṃ, kato ca te citta paṭissavo mayā.

77001.meaning1: for the sake of livelihood; to make a living
77001.commentary: (THa) ājīvahetū'ti ājīvakāraṇā jīvik'āpakato hutvā ājīvikābhayena ahaṃ na nikkhamiṃ na pabbajiṃ.

examples.text: n'āhaṃ alakkhyā ahirikkatāya vā, na cittahetū na ca dūrakantanā, ājīvahetū ca ahaṃ na nikkhamiṃ, kato ca te citta paṭissavo mayā.
sabbattha te citta vaco kataṃ mayā, bahūsu jātīsu na me'si kopito, ajjhattasambhavo kataññutāya te, dukkhe ciraṃ saṃsaritaṃ tayā kate.

77003.meaning1: plunged into and inhabited by wild boar and black antelope
77003.commentary: (THa) varāha-eṇeyya-vigāḷha-sevite'ti varāhehi c'eva eṇeyyehi ca ogāhetvā sevite.

examples.text: varāha-eṇeyya-vigāḷha-sevite, pabbhārakuṭṭe pakat'eva sundare, nav'ambunā pāvusasitthakānane, tahiṃ guhāgehagato ramissasi.
sunīlagīvā susikhā supekhunā, sucittapattacchadanā vihaṅ'gamā, sumañjughosatthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

77005.meaning1: very sweet; truly lovely; extremely charming

examples.text: sunīlagīvā susikhā supekhunā, sucittapattacchadanā vihaṅ'gamā, sumañjughosatthanit'ābhigajjino, te taṃ ramessanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ.

77006.commentary: (THa) vīriyena taṃ mayha vasānayissan'ti, ambho citta, taṃ attano vīriyena bhāvanābalaṃ uppādetvā tena mayhaṃ vasaṃ ānayissaṃ.

examples.text: tathā tu kassāmi yathā'pi issaro, yaṃ labbhati tena'pi hotu me alaṃ, vīriyena taṃ mayha vas'ānayissaṃ, gajaṃ'va mattaṃ kusal'aṅkusaggaho.

77007.commentary: (THa) gajaṃ'va mattaṃ kusal'aṅkusaggaho'ti yathā kusalo cheko aṅkusaggaho hatth'ācariyo attano sikkhābalena mattahatthiṃ attano vasaṃ āneti, tath'evā'ti attho.

examples.text: tathā tu kassāmi yathā'pi issaro, yaṃ labbhati tena'pi hotu me alaṃ, vīriyena taṃ mayha vas'ānayissaṃ, gajaṃ'va mattaṃ kusal'aṅkusaggaho.

77008.grammar: fut 1st sg of nibandhati, irreg form of nibandhissaṃ, trans (+acc)
77008.meaning1: I will bind; I shall tie
77008.commentary: (THa) ārammaṇe taṃ balasā nibandhisaṃ, nāgaṃ'va thambhamhi daḷhāya rajjuyā'ti yathā hatth'ācariyo mahāhatthiṃ āḷānathambhe daḷhāya thirāya rajjuyā nibandhati, evam'ahaṃ, citta, kammaṭṭhān'ārammaṇe bhāvanābalena nibandhissaṃ.

examples.text: ārammaṇe taṃ balasā nibandhisaṃ, nāgaṃ'va thambhamhi daḷhāya rajjuyā, taṃ me suguttaṃ satiyā subhāvitaṃ, anissitaṃ sabbabhavesu hehisi.
migo yathā seri sucittakānane, rammaṃ giriṃ pāvusaabbhamāliniṃ, anākule tattha nage ramissaṃ, asaṃsayaṃ citta parā bhavissasi.
migo yathā seri sucittakānane, rammaṃ giriṃ pāvusaabbhamāliniṃ, anākule tattha nage ramissaṃ, asaṃsayaṃ citta parā bhavissasi.

77011.commentary: (THa) rammaṃ giriṃ pāvusaabbhamālinin'ti evaṃ pāvusakāle samantato sumālinīhi thalajajalajamālāhi samannāgatattā abbhamāliniṃ janavivittatāya manoramatāya ca rammaṃ pabbataṃ labhitvā tattha nage ramissaṃ

examples.text: migo yathā seri sucittakānane, rammaṃ giriṃ pāvusaabbhamāliniṃ, anākule tattha nage ramissaṃ, asaṃsayaṃ citta parā bhavissasi.

aṭṭhikaṅkalakuṭike, maṃsanhārupasibbite, dhi'r'atthu pure duggandhe, paragatte mamāyase.

77014.meaning1: sewn up with meat and tendons; stitched together with flesh and sinews

examples.text: aṭṭhikaṅkalakuṭike, maṃsanhārupasibbite, dhi'r'atthu pure duggandhe, paragatte mamāyase.

77015.meaning1: limbs of another; body of someone else
77015.commentary: (THa) paragatte mamāyase'ti idañ'ca te duggandhassa upari phoṭasamuṭṭhānaṃ parissayaṃ evaṃ asuciduggandhaṃ jegucchaṃ paṭikkūlasamādānaṃ tādise eva aññasmiṃ padese soṇasiṅgālakimikul'ādīnaṃ gattabhūte kaḷevare mamattaṃ karosi.

examples.text: aṭṭhikaṅkalakuṭike, maṃsanhārupasibbite, dhi'r'atthu pure duggandhe, paragatte mamāyase.

77016.meaning1: wrapped in skin; bound in hide

examples.text: gūthabhaste tac'onaddhe, uragaṇḍipisācini, nava sotāni te kāye, yāni sandanti sabbadā.

77017.commentary: (THa) uragaṇḍipisācinī'ti ure ṭhitagaṇḍadvayavatī bhayānakabhāvato anatth'āvahato ca pisācasadisī.

examples.text: gūthabhaste tac'onaddhe, uragaṇḍipisācini, nava sotāni te kāye, yāni sandanti sabbadā.

77018.commentary: (THa) uragaṇḍipisācinī'ti ure ṭhitagaṇḍadvayavatī bhayānakabhāvato anatth'āvahato ca pisācasadisī.

examples.text: gūthabhaste tac'onaddhe, uragaṇḍipisācini, nava sotāni te kāye, yāni sandanti sabbadā.

77019.meaning1: she-devil with boils on her chest
77019.commentary: (THa) uragaṇḍipisācinī'ti ure ṭhitagaṇḍadvayavatī bhayānakabhāvato anatth'āvahato ca pisācasadisī.

examples.text: gūthabhaste tac'onaddhe, uragaṇḍipisācini, nava sotāni te kāye, yāni sandanti sabbadā.
tava sarīraṃ navasotaṃ, duggandhakaraṃ paribandhaṃ, bhikkhu parivajjayate taṃ, mīḷhaṃ ca yathā sucikāmo.

77021.meaning1: fond of purity; who likes cleanliness
77021.commentary: (THa) mīḷhañ'ca yathā sucikāmo'ti… yathā sucijātiko sucim'eva icchanto sasīsaṃ nhāto mīḷhaṃ disvā dūrato'va parivajjesi, evam'evaṃ bhikkhū'ti attho.

examples.text: tava sarīraṃ navasotaṃ, duggandhakaraṃ paribandhaṃ, bhikkhu parivajjayate taṃ, mīḷhaṃ ca yathā sucikāmo.

77022.grammar: inf of caus of √raj, caus, trans (+acc)

examples.text: ākāsamhi haliddiyā, yo maññetha rajetave, aññena vā'pi raṅgena, vighāt'udayam'eva taṃ.

77023.meaning1: cause of affliction; source of annoyance
77023.commentary: (THa) tass'attho, yo puggalo haliddiyā aññena vā raṅgajātena ākāsaṃ rañjituṃ maññeyya, tassa taṃ kammaṃ vighāt'udayaṃ cittavighāt'āvaham'eva siyā, yathā taṃ avisaye yogo.

examples.text: ākāsamhi haliddiyā, yo maññetha rajetave, aññena vā'pi raṅgena, vighāt'udayam'eva taṃ.

77024.commentary: (THa) mā pāpacitte āsādī'ti kāmesu nimuggatāya lāmakacitte nihīnacitte mādise mā āsādehi.

examples.text: tadākāsasamaṃ cittaṃ, ajjhattaṃ susamāhitaṃ, mā pāpacitte āsādi, aggikhandhaṃ'va pakkhimā.
vivaram'anupabhanti vijjutā, vebhārassa ca paṇḍavassa ca, nagavivaragato jhāyati, putto appaṭimassa tādino.

77026.meaning1: (of a Brahman) accomplished in the Vedas; consummate in the sacred scriptures

examples.text: yo ca jātisataṃ gacche, sabbā brāhmaṇajātiyo, sottiyo vedasampanno, manussesu punappunaṃ.

77027.commentary: (THa) aṭṭha vimokkhānī'ti rūpajjhān'ādike aṭṭha vimokkhe. bhāvan'āvasena hi laddhāni rūpajjhānāni paccanīkadhammehi suṭṭhu vimuttataṃ abhirativasena ārammaṇe nirāsaṅgañ'ca pavattiṃ upādāya vimokkhānī'ti vuccanti. nirodhasamāpatti pana paccanīkadhammehi vimuttattā eva. idha pana jhānam'eva veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: yo so aṭṭha vimokkhāni, purebhattaṃ aphassayi, anulomaṃ paṭilomaṃ, tato piṇḍāya gacchati.

77029.commentary: (THa) mā te vijaṭi matthakan'ti tava matthakaṃ tasmiṃ katena aparādhena sattadhā mā phali.

examples.text: tādisaṃ bhikkhuṃ m'āsādi, m'āttānaṃ khaṇi brāhmaṇa, abhippasādehi manaṃ, arahantamhi tādine, khippaṃ pañjaliko vanda, mā te vijaṭi matthakaṃ.
n'eso passati saddhammaṃ, saṃsārena purakkhato, adhogamaṃ jimhapathaṃ, kummaggam'anudhāvati.

77031.meaning1: smeared with excrement; soiled with dung
77031.commentary: (THa) kimī'va mīḷhasallitto'ti gūthakimī viya mīḷhena samantato litto

examples.text: kimī'va mīḷhasallitto, saṅkhāre adhimucchito, pagāḷho lābhasakkāre, tuccho gacchati poṭṭhilo.

77032.commentary: (THa) tuccho gacchati poṭṭhilo'ti adhisīlasikkh'ābhāvato tuccho asāro hutvā poṭṭhilo bhikkhu gacchati pavattati.
77032.notes: Perhaps from Sanskrit pauti, a vṛddhi form of pūti in compounds.

examples.text: kimī'va mīḷhasallitto, saṅkhāre adhimucchito, pagāḷho lābhasakkāre, tuccho gacchati poṭṭhilo.

77033.meaning1: eradicated the bonds; worn away the fetters

examples.text: visallaṃ khīṇasaṃyogaṃ, tevijjaṃ maccuhāyinaṃ, dakkhiṇeyyaṃ manussānaṃ, puññakkhettaṃ anuttaraṃ.

77034.meaning1: one thousand deities; a thousand gods

examples.text: ete sambahulā devā, iddhimanto yasassino, dasa devasahassāni, sabbe brahmapurohitā, moggallānaṃ namassantā, tiṭṭhanti pañjalīkatā.

77035.meaning1: falling and arising; death and rebirth; passing away and being reborn

examples.text: yassa muhuttena sahassadhā loko, saṃvidito sabrahmakappo vasi, iddhiguṇe cut'upapāte kāle, passati devatā sa bhikkhu.

77036.meaning1: attained mastery and perfection of meditative composure and wisdom
77036.commentary: (THa) samādhivijjāvasipāramīgato'ti savitakka-savicār'ādi-samādhīsu c'eva pubbenivāsañāṇ'ādivijjāsu ca vasībhāvena pāramiṃ koṭiṃ patto asi.

examples.text: samādhivijjāvasipāramīgato, moggallānagotto asitassa sāsane, dhīro samucchindi samāhit'indriyo, nāgo yathā pūtilataṃ'va bandhanaṃ.

77037.meaning1: belonging to the Moggallāna family clan

examples.text: samādhivijjāvasipāramīgato, moggallānagotto asitassa sāsane, dhīro samucchindi samāhit'indriyo, nāgo yathā pūtilataṃ'va bandhanaṃ.

77038.meaning1: remaining for an aeon; lasting for a world cycle
77038.commentary: (THa) majjhesarasmin'ti mahāsamuddassa majjhe kira udakaṃ vatthuṃ katvā nibbattavimānāni kappaṭṭhitikāni honti. ten'āha vimānā kappaṭhāyino'ti.

examples.text: majjhesarasmiṃ tiṭṭhanti, vimānā kappaṭhāyino, veḷuriyavaṇṇā rucirā, accimanto pabhassarā, accharā tattha naccanti, puthu nānattavaṇṇiyo.

77039.commentary: (THa) bālo eva pana ayaṃ mandāgatī'ti anijalantaṃ viya jalitaṃ aggiṃ āsajja naṃ paḍayhati, evam'eva, māra, na mayaṃ ḍahitu'kāmā, bādhetu'kāmā, tvaññ'eva pana tathā āgaman'ādiatthena tathāgataṃ aggikhandhasadisaṃ ariyasāvakaṃ āsajja attānaṃ ḍahissasi, ḍahadukkhato na muñcissasi.

examples.text: na ve aggi cetayati, ahaṃ bālaṃ ḍahāmī'ti, bālo'va jalitaṃ aggiṃ, āsajja naṃ paḍayhati.

77040.construction:
daḷha + dhanu + a + ī
daḷhadhanva + ī
77040.commentary: (THa) daḷhadhammino'ti, daḷhadhanuno. daḷhadhanu nāma dvisahassathāmaṃ vuccati. dvisahassathāman'ti, ca yassa āropitassa jiyāya bandho lohasīs'ādīnaṃ bhāro daṇḍe gahetvā yāva kaṇḍapamāṇā nabhaṃ ukkhittassa pathavito muccati.

examples.text: uggaputtā mah'issāsā, sikkhitā daḷhadhanvino, samantā parikireyyuṃ, sahassaṃ apalāyinaṃ.
atha saṭṭhisitā savitakkā, puthujjanatāya adhammā niviṭṭhā, na ca vaggagatassa kuhiñci, no pana duṭṭhullagāhī sa bhikkhu.

77042.meaning1: fact of being a common man; fact of being a normal person
77042.commentary: (THa) puthujjanatāya adhammā niviṭṭhā'ti te pana micchāvitakkā nicc'ādigāhavasena adhammā dhammato apetā puthujjanatāyaṃ andhabāle niviṭṭhā abhiniviṭṭhā.

examples.text: atha saṭṭhisitā savitakkā, puthujjanatāya adhammā niviṭṭhā, na ca vaggagatassa kuhiñci, no pana duṭṭhullagāhī sa bhikkhu.

77043.commentary: (THa) paṭibhānaṃ udiyyatī'ti kathetu'kamyatāya sati samuddato vīciyo viya upar'ūpari anantaṃ paṭibhānaṃ uṭṭhahati.

examples.text: saṅkhittena'pi deseti, vitthārena'pi bhāsati, sālikāy'iva nigghoso, paṭibhānaṃ udiyyati.

77044.meaning1: commentary on that; explanation of that

examples.text: [appiyehi… vippayogo dukkho'ti-pāṭho c'eva taṃniddeso ca katthaci na dissati, aṭṭhakathāyaṃ'pi taṃsaṃvaṇṇanā n'atthi]
ummaggapathaṃ mārassa, abhibhuyya carati pabhijja khīlāni, taṃ passatha bandhapamuñcakaraṃ, asitaṃ'va bhāgaso pavibhajja.

77046.commentary: (THa) pavibhajjā'ti'pi pāṭho. uddes'ādikoṭṭhāsato pakārena vibhajitvā vibhajitvā dhammaṃ desetī'ti attho.

examples.text: ummaggapathaṃ mārassa, abhibhuyya carati pabhijja khīlāni, taṃ passatha bandhapamuñcakaraṃ, asitaṃ'va bhāgaso pavibhajja.

77047.meaning1: purpose of crossing; sake of getting across

examples.text: oghassa hi nitaraṇ'atthaṃ, anekavihitaṃ maggaṃ akkhāsi, tasmiñ'ca amate akkhāte, dhammadasā ṭhitā asaṃhīrā.

77048.meaning1: skilled in mind reading; expert in encompassing the mind
77048.commentary: (THa) cetopariyakovido'ti chasu abhiññāsu catasso vadati, itarā dve yadi'pi na vuttā, thero pana chaḷabhiñño'va.

examples.text: mah'ānubhāvo tevijjo, cetopariyakovido, koṇḍañño buddhadāy'ādo, pāde vandati satthuno.

77049.meaning1: attained the perfection of higher understanding; (or) reached perfection in psychic power

examples.text: abhiññāpāramippatto, sotadhātu visodhitā, tevijjo iddhipatto'mhi, cetopariyakovido.
nigrodhakappo iti tassa nāmaṃ, tayā kataṃ bhagavā brāhmaṇassa, so taṃ namassaṃ acari muty'apekho, āraddhavīriyo daḷhadhammadassī.

77051.meaning1: of superior power; with supreme energy

examples.text: paroparaṃ ariyadhammaṃ viditvā, mā mohayī jānam'anomavīriya, vāriṃ yathā ghammani ghammatatto, vāc'ābhikaṅkhāmi sutaṃ pavassa.

77052.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; Nigrodhakappa

examples.text: addasa bhagavā ādiṃ, upādānassa kappiyo, accagā vata kappāno, maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ.

77053.grammar: card, fem loc sg, comp, irreg form of sattatiyaṃ

examples.text: sattatimhi nipātamhi, vaṅg'īso paṭibhāṇavā, eko'va thero n'atth'añño, gāthāyo ekasattatīti.
sīhanādaṃ naditvāna, buddhaputtā anāsavā, khem'antaṃ pāpuṇitvāna, aggikhandhā'va nibbutā'ti.

77055.synonym: anupāpuṇitvā, appetvā, upagantvā, pāpuṇitvā, phassayitvā, phusayitvā, phussayitvā

examples.text: sīhanādaṃ naditvāna, buddhaputtā anāsavā, khem'antaṃ pāpuṇitvāna, aggikhandhā'va nibbutā'ti.

77056.meaning1: name of an arahant monk; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost monk in eloquence; Soṇa Kuṭikaṇṇa
77056.meaningLit: elder crooked ear; (comm) elder with earrings worth ten billion
77056.notes: Theragāthā verse 365 (TH5.11, TH208) is attributed to him.

77057.meaning1: born of the flesh; (comm) arising in bodies
77057.commentary: (THa) sarīrajā'ti sarīresu uppajjanaka. pañcavokārabhave hi cittaṃ rūpapaṭibaddhavuttitāya sarīrajan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: olaggessāmi te citta, āṇidvāre'va hatthinaṃ, na taṃ pāpe niyojessaṃ, kāmajāla sarīraja.

77058.commentary: (THa) so tena puññakammena devamanussesu saṃsaranto kassapassa bhagavato sāsane mātule pabbajante tena saddhiṃ pabbajitvā bahuṃ vivaṭṭ'ūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinitvā imasmiṃ buddh'uppāde vanavacchattherassa bhāgineyyo hutvā nibbatto, sivako'ti'ssa nāmaṃ ahosi. tassa mātā attano jeṭṭhabhātike vanavacche sāsane pabbajitvā pabbajitakiccaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā araññe viharante taṃ pavattiṃ sutvā puttaṃ āha, tāta sivaka, therassa santike pabbajitvā theraṃ upaṭṭhaha, mahallako dāni thero'ti. so mātu ekavacaneneva ca pubbe kat'ādhikāratāya ca mātulattherassa santikaṃ gantvā pabbajitvā taṃ upaṭṭhahanto araññe vasati.
77058.notes: Theragāthā verse 14 (TH1.14, TH14) is attributed to him.

77059.meaning1: being dirtied (by); being soiled (by); becoming impure (through)
77059.commentary: (THa) saṅkhāresu saṃkilissamānāse'ti ajjhattikabāhiresu cakkh'ādīsu c'eva rūp'ādīsu ca saṅkhatadhammesu saṃkilissamānā, etaṃ mama, eso'ham'asmi, eso me attā'ti taṃnimittaṃ taṇhāgāh'ādi-vasena saṃkilesaṃ āpajjamānā.

examples.text: mānena vañcitāse, saṅkhāresu saṅkilissamānāse, lābh'ālābhena mathitā, samādhiṃ n'ādhigacchantī'ti.

77060.meaning1: all states of being; (or) all points of view

examples.text: pajjotakaro ativijjha, sabbaṭhitīnaṃ atikkamam'addasa, ñatvā ca sacchikatvā ca, aggaṃ so desayi das'addhānaṃ.

77061.meaning1: defiled for a long time; long tarnished
77061.commentary: (THa) tass'attho, kañjiyapuṇṇalābu viya takkabharitacāṭi viya vasāpītapilotikā viya ca saṃkilesavatthūhi anamatagge saṃsāre cirakālaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ.

examples.text: cirasaṅkiliṭṭhaṃ vata maṃ, diṭṭhisandānabandhitaṃ, vimocayi so bhagavā, sabbaganthehi senakan'ti.

77063.commentary: (THa) ñātakā hotu, vaḍḍhitakāle amhākaṃ ayyassa sāriputtattherassa santike taṃ pabbājessāmā'ti vatvā saṅkunā chinnakkhikoṭitāya saṃkicco'ti vadantā aparabhāge saṃkicco'ti vohariṃsu. so sattavassikakāle attano gabbhagatasseva mātu maraṇaṃ, gabbhe ca attano pavattiṃ sutvā saṃvegajāto pabbajissāmī'ti āha. ñātakā sādhu, tātā'ti dhammasenāpatissa santikaṃ netvā, bhante, imaṃ pabbājethā'ti adaṃsu. thero taṃ tacapañcakakammaṭṭhānaṃ datvā pabbājesi.
77063.notes: Theragāthā verses 597-607 (TH11.1, TH240) are attributed to him.

77064.meaning1: taking pleasure in kindness; delighting in benevolence

examples.text: sabbamitto sabbasakho, sabbabhūt'ānukampako, mettacittañ'ca bhāvemi, abyāpajjarato sadā.

77065.commentary: (THa) saṃcintaye'ti vuccamāne bhave anicc'ādito manasi kareyyaṃ vipasseyyan'ti attho.

examples.text: kadā mayūrassa sikhaṇḍino vane, dijassa sutvā girigabbhare rutaṃ, paccuṭṭhahitvā amatassa pattiyā, sañcintaye taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

77066.grammar: ind, adv, interr, comp, abl sg of kiṅkāraṇa
77066.meaning1: for what reason?; because of what?; why?
77066.commentary: (NIDD1a) kiṃkāraṇā vuccati methunadhammo'ti kena kāraṇena kena pariyāyena methunadhammo'ti kathīyati.

examples.text: bahūni vassāni tay'āmhi yācito, agāravāsena alaṃ nu te idaṃ, taṃ dāni maṃ pabbajitaṃ samānaṃ, kiṅkāraṇā citta tuvaṃ na yuñjasi.

77067.meaning1: freeing one from all bonds; liberating one from all ties

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ sithilam'ārabbha, na'y'idaṃ appena thāmasā, nibbānam'adhigantabbaṃ, sabbaganthapamocanaṃ.

77068.commentary: (THa) n'ekesaṃ saṃgatībhāvā'ti, catumahābhūta-jīvit'indriya-assāsapassāsa-viññāṇ'ādīnaṃ samavāyasambandhena suttamerakasamavāyena yan'taṃ viya ṭhān'ādi-iriyāpathaṃ kappeti.

examples.text: aṭṭhisaṅghātaghaṭito, nhārusuttanibandhano, n'ekesaṃ saṅgatībhāvā, kappeti iriyāpathaṃ.

77069.meaning1: having produced; having manifested; having displayed
77069.commentary: (THa) sitaṃ pātukaritvānā'ti attano ovādassa mahapphalataṃ devabrahmūnañ'ca guṇasampattiṃ nissāya satthā sitaṃ pātv'ākāsi. pātukaronto ca na aññe viya dante vidaṃseti, mukh'ādhānaṃ pana thokaṃ vivarati, tattakena ca abhibhūta-dibbaphalika-mutta-rasmiyo avahasitatārakāsasimarīciyo susukkadāṭhasambhavā ghanarasmiyo nikkhamitvā tikkhattuṃ satthu mukhaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ karonti, taṃ disvā pacchato gacchantā'pi satthā sitaṃ pātv'ākāsī'ti sañjānanti.

examples.text: tato disvāna maṃ satthā, devasaṅghapurakkhataṃ, sitaṃ pātukaritvāna, imam'atthaṃ abhāsatha.

77070.commentary: (THa) paralābh'opajīvantā'ti sāsane lābhassa andhabālaputhujjanehi pare sīl'ādiguṇasampanne sekkhe uddissa uppannattā taṃ paralābhaṃ, parato vā dāyakato laddhabbalābhaṃ upajīvantā bhaṇḍanakārakā bhikkhū pāpajigucchāya abhāvato ahirikā samānā ca mayaṃ paralābhaṃ bhuñjāma

examples.text: saṅghalābhassa bhaṇḍanti, saṅghato paribāhirā, paralābh'opajīvantā, ahirīkā na lajjare.

77071.meaning1: variously become; occurred in many ways
77071.commentary: (THa) nānappayātamhī'ti nānappakāre bhedanadhamme payāte samakate, nānappakārena vā saṃkilesadhamme payātuṃ pavattituṃ āraddhe.

examples.text: evaṃ nānappayātamhi, na dāni sukaraṃ tathā, aphusitaṃ vā phusituṃ, phusitaṃ v'ānurakkhituṃ.

77072.commentary: (THa) paṇḍarasagotto'ti paṇḍarassa nāma isino vaṃse jātattā tena samānagotto.
77072.notes: Either refers to being clothed in white, or having the body smeared in ashes. See Edgerton pāṇḍarabhikṣu/

examples.text: pāsādike bahū disvā, bhāvitatte susaṃvute, isi paṇḍarasagotto, apucchi phussasavhayaṃ.
pāsādike bahū disvā, bhāvitatte susaṃvute, isi paṇḍarasagotto, apucchi phussasavhayaṃ.

77074.meaning1: sage called Paṇḍara; seer by the name of White

examples.text: suṇohi vacanaṃ mayhaṃ, isipaṇḍarasavhaya, sakkaccaṃ upadhārehi, ācikkhissāmy'anāgataṃ.

77075.meaning1: meditator who is restrained in thought
77075.commentary: (THa) yatasaṅkappajjhāyī'ti sabbaso micchāsaṅkappaṃ pahāya nekkhammasaṅkapp'ādi-vasena saṃyatasaṅkappo hutvā ārammaṇ'ūpanijjhānena lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānena ca jhāyanasīlo.

examples.text: yathācārī yathāsato satīmā, yatasaṅkappajjhāyi appamatto, ajjhattarato samāhit'atto, eko santusito tam'āhu bhikkhuṃ.

77076.meaning1: knowing the sequence; understanding the order

examples.text: pubb'āparaññū atthaññū, niruttipadakovido, suggahītañ'ca gaṇhāti, atthañ'c'opaparikkhati.

77077.commentary: (THa) rammaṃ giriṃ pāvusaabbhamālinin'ti evaṃ pāvusakāle samantato sumālinīhi thalajajalajamālāhi samannāgatattā abbhamāliniṃ janavivittatāya manoramatāya ca rammaṃ pabbataṃ labhitvā tattha nage ramissaṃ

examples.text: migo yathā seri sucittakānane, rammaṃ giriṃ pāvusaabbhamāliniṃ, anākule tattha nage ramissaṃ, asaṃsayaṃ citta parā bhavissasi.

77079.meaning1: who cuts off; who breaks off; who severs

77082.grammar: pp of pati saṃ √yu, in comps (+instr)

examples.text: yathā abbhāni verambho, vāto nudati pāvuse, saññā me abhikiranti, vivekapaṭisaññutā.

77083.grammar: fem, abstr, from na sāmika, neg
77083.meaning1: fact of having no owner; fact of being ownerless
77083.construction:
na > a + sāmī + ka + tā
asāmika + tā

77084.construction:
su > so + √man + as + *ya + ita
somanassa + ita
77084.synonym: attamana, ānandī, āraddhacitta, patītarūpa, pamodavant, sumana, summana, somanassajāta

examples.text: tam'enaṃ rajako yasmiṃ yasmiṃ raṅgajāte upasaṃhareyya, yadi nīlakāya yadi pītakāya yadi lohitakāya yadi mañjeṭṭhakāya durattavaṇṇam'ev'assa aparisuddhavaṇṇam'ev'assa.

77090.grammar: pr, from na paṭibhāsati, neg, trans (+acc)
77090.meaning1: does not speak against; does not object (to)
77090.construction:
na + pati + bhāsa + ti
na + paṭibhāsati

77091.commentary: (SNa) yo maññatī'ti yo attānaṃ ahaṃ samo'ti vā visesī'ti vā nihīno'ti vā maññati. etena seyyo'ham'asmī'tiādayo tayo mānā gahitā'va. tesu gahitesu nava mānā gahitā'va honti.

examples.text: samo visesī uda vā nihīno, yo maññatī so vivadetha tena, tīsu vidhāsu avikampamāno, samo visesī'ti na tassa hoti.

77092.meaning1: one who seeks alms; almsman; food beggar

examples.text: antam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, jīvikānaṃ yadidaṃ piṇḍolyaṃ. abhisāpo'yaṃ, bhikkhave, lokasmiṃ, piṇḍolo vicarasi pattapāṇī'ti.

77093.commentary: (SNa) cakkhu ca taṃ cakkhudvāre nibbattānaṃ dhammānaṃ ādhipateyyasaṅkhātena ind'aṭṭhena indriyañ'cā'ti cakkhu'ndriyaṃ

examples.text: varaṃ, bhikkhave, tattāya ayosalākāya ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya cakkhu-indriyaṃ sampalimaṭṭhaṃ, na tv'eva cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anubyañjanaso nimittaggāho.

77094.grammar: masc, from na vipayoga, neg x2, caus (+abl)
77094.construction: na > a + vi + pa + yoje > yoge + a

examples.text: sati'pi ca n'esaṃ katthaci avippayoge iṭṭhārammaṇapaṭilābhatuṭṭhi pīti, paṭiladdharasānubhavanaṃ sukhaṃ. yattha pīti tattha sukhaṃ, yattha sukhaṃ tattha na niyamato pīti.

77095.meaning1: fact of being indifferent; fact of disregarding; fact of being unconcerned; fact of observing disinterestedly
77095.construction:
adhi > adhy > ajjhi + upa + √ikkh + ana + tā
ajjhupekkhana + tā

examples.text: paññāyissanti sakena kammenā'ti sukhadukkhesu ajjhupekkhanatā upekkhā. gāthābandhasukhatthaṃ pana uppaṭipāṭiyā mettaṃ vatvā upekkhā vuttā, muditā pacchā.

77096.commentary: (THIa) lokaṃ ādissa vaṇṇitā'ti kalyāṇamitte anugantabban'ti sattalokaṃ uddissa

examples.text: kalyāṇamittatā muninā, lokaṃ ādissa vaṇṇitā, kalyāṇamitte bhajamāno, api bālo paṇḍito assa.
akālacīvaraṃ nāma anatthate kathine ekādasamāse uppannaṃ, atthate kathine sattamāse uppannaṃ, kāle'pi ādissa dinnaṃ, etaṃ akālacīvaraṃ nāma.

77098.commentary: (SNPa) na munī gāmam'āgamma, kulesu sahasā care'ti so ca mon'atthāya paṭipannako muni gāmaṃ gato samāno kulesu sahasā na care, sahasokit'ādiananulomikaṃ gihisaṃsaggaṃ na āpajjeyyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: na munī gāmam'āgamma, kulesu sahasā care. ghās'esanaṃ chinnakatho, na vācaṃ payutaṃ bhaṇe.
